decisions.decision: Reset all P0 gate claims to reflect reality
decisions.rationale: Previous P0_GATE.json had training_allowed=true with PARTIAL checks and pending hashes. Planning doc prohibits manual gate override.

decisions.decision: Preserve existing event_runtime/ and random_event/ modules; integrate via runtime_bridge.py
decisions.rationale: Planning doc Phase C: 'Do not rewrite the entire environment. Prioritize bridge/adapter.'

decisions.decision: Unify preliminary seeds to [1101, 2202, 3303]; Validation to 100 tapes (25x4); burst window to 0.1s
decisions.rationale: Planning doc Phases B and G explicitly require these values.

decisions.decision: PPOTrainer supports all three variants: PPO-MLP, GPPO-NoGate, GPPO-Adaptive
decisions.rationale: Planning doc Phase F: 'PPOTrainer must simultaneously support all three.'

decisions.decision: Create scripts/build_p0_gate.py for machine-generated gates; training entry points read it
decisions.rationale: Planning doc Phase H: 'Gate must be machine-generated. Manual training_allowed=true prohibited.'

decisions.decision: Gate stays RED until legacy_compatibility suite passes on locked env (Python 3.11 + sb3_contrib)
decisions.rationale: Planning doc Phase I gate list includes 'CPP / legacy compatibility'. Missing dependency must keep gate false, not silently pass.
